parlay_correlation_assumption: Different-game outcomes are treated as approximately independent (near-zero correlation). Same-game legs are high-correlation and are excluded from parlays.
luck_vs_skill: Luck is removed by requiring: a documented skill basis, a minimum sample size, and realized results statistically distinguishable from chance (binomial test vs .500, ROI convergence). New strategies are provisional until tracked.
